sections.t: Toronto Jr Canadiens at Toronto Marlboros
b: The game: Toronto Jr Canadiens (#4, 98.23) at Toronto Marlboros (#3, 98.32), Friday 6:40 PM, CWENCH Centre in Etobicoke. First against second in Ontario, 0.09 rating points apart.
Head to head: the Marlboros won both meetings, 3-2 on Oct 11 and 2-0 on Oct 25.
Marlboros to watch: Cal Reilly, 21 goals and 39 points in 25 games. In goal, Austin Kay-Schilke has allowed 1.50 goals a game in 12 games.
The Jr Canadiens arrive off three wins in Chicago last weekend, the last one 3-1 over Team Illinois (#7, 97.12).
Right behind them: North York Rangers (#5, 98.21) hosts Vaughan Kings (#21, 95.99) on Saturday at 2:30 PM. The top three in Ontario are within 0.11 of each other.
Sunday: Jr Canadiens host Markham Majors at 2:15 PM. Marlboros at Don Mills Flyers at 8:00 PM.
Team Illinois (#7, 97.12): four games in the Chicago suburbs against Madison Capitols, Midwest Warriors, Milwaukee Jr Admirals and CarShield.
Biggby Coffee: four games at the Tier 1 Hockey Federation showcase near Pittsburgh.
Top Gun (Elite) plays Boston Jr Eagles (Elite) on Saturday morning in Salem, NH.
HB Detroit plays Victory Honda in a league game on Saturday.
